nodes.description: msg.sender - caller controlled address used for ownership, request keys and payment destinations
block.timestamp (now) - miner influenced time used for request expiration logic
msg.sender.transfer(amount) in withdrawRequest - external Ether transfer to caller
msg.sender.transfer(reward.sub(commission)) in auditContract - external Ether transfer to auditor
msg.sender.transfer(_amount) in withdrawCommission - external Ether transfer to owner
owner - privileged account state variable controlling onlyOwner functions
paused - emergency stop flag read by whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers
newContractAddress - address of replacement contract set on upgrade
totalRequestsAmount - aggregated amount of audit requests held by contract
availableCommission - collected commission withdrawable by owner
commission - service commission percentage (default 9)
rewards - mapping of auditor/codeHash key to offered reward amount
auditOutcomes - mapping of auditor/codeHash key to audit outcome code
auditRequests - mapping of auditor/requestor/codeHash key to AuditRequest struct
MIN_AUDIT_TIME constant (24 hours) bounding audit request duration
MAX_AUDIT_TIME constant (28 days) bounding audit request duration
MAX_COMMISION constant (33) bounding the commission percentage
Ownable() constructor - sets owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address newOwner) - onlyOwner transfer of ownership
pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused - sets paused = true
Pausable.unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused - sets paused = false
setNewAddress(address _v2Address) onlyOwner whenPaused - registers upgrade contract
requestAudit(address _auditor, bytes32 _codeHash, uint _auditTime) payable - registers a payable audit request
withdrawRequest(address _auditor, bytes32 _codeHash) - refunds an expired audit request
auditContract(bytes32 _codeHash, bool _isApproved) - records audit outcome and pays reward
changeCommission(uint _newCommission) onlyOwner whenNotPaused - updates commission
calcCommission(uint _amount) private view - computes commission = amount * commission / 100
withdrawCommission(uint _amount) onlyOwner - pays out accumulated commission
SolidStamp.unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused - overrides base unpause after upgrade check
fallback function payable - reverts any direct Ether transfers
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) - checked multiplication
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) - checked subtraction
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) - checked addition
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
_v2Address parameter of setNewAddress
_auditor parameter of requestAudit (untrusted address)
_codeHash parameter of requestAudit
_auditTime parameter of requestAudit
_auditor parameter of withdrawRequest
_codeHash parameter of withdrawRequest
_codeHash parameter of auditContract
_isApproved parameter of auditContract
_newCommission parameter of changeCommission
_amount parameter of withdrawCommission
_amount parameter of calcCommission
hashAuditorCode = keccak256(_auditor, _codeHash) in requestAudit
outcome read from auditOutcomes in requestAudit
currentReward read from rewards in requestAudit
expireDate = now + _auditTime in requestAudit
hashAuditorRequestorCode = keccak256(_auditor, msg.sender, _codeHash)
storage pointer request into auditRequests in requestAudit
storage pointer request into auditRequests in withdrawRequest
amount read from request.amount in withdrawRequest
reward read from rewards in auditContract
commission computed by calcCommission in auditContract

edges.reason: Ownable constructor reads msg.sender to bootstrap ownership
constructor writes owner state variable
onlyOwner modifier enforces require(msg.sender == owner)
owner state variable is overwritten with caller supplied newOwner
transferOwnership writes owner
pause is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
pause sets paused to true
base unpause is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
base unpause sets paused to false
newContractAddress is set from the _v2Address parameter
setNewAddress writes newContractAddress
setNewAddress is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
whenPaused modifier reads paused state variable
msg.sender is used as the requestor identity and request key in requestAudit
expireDate is derived from block.timestamp (now.add(_auditTime))
_auditTime parameter is added to now to compute expireDate
requestAudit uses SafeMath.add for rewards and totalRequestsAmount
_codeHash is hashed into hashAuditorCode
_auditor is hashed into hashAuditorCode
hashAuditorCode indexes the rewards mapping
hashAuditorCode indexes the auditOutcomes mapping
whenNotPaused modifier reads the paused state variable
MIN_AUDIT_TIME constant bounds the _auditTime parameter
MAX_AUDIT_TIME constant bounds the _auditTime parameter
requestAudit increases totalRequestsAmount
requestAudit increases rewards entry
requestAudit writes the auditRequests entry
storage pointer request aliases auditRequests entry
outcome local is read from auditOutcomes
currentReward local is read from rewards
hashAuditorRequestorCode is the auditRequests mapping key built from msg.sender
msg.sender determines which audit request may be withdrawn
require(now > request.expireDate) makes withdrawal timing depend on block.timestamp
withdrawRequest performs an external Ether transfer to the caller
amount local is copied from the stored request
withdrawRequest decreases the rewards entry
withdrawRequest decreases totalRequestsAmount
withdrawRequest uses SafeMath.sub for rewards and totalRequestsAmount
user controlled amount is sent out via the external transfer
msg.sender is the auditor whose outcome and reward are processed
_codeHash parameter is used to build the auditor/code key
_isApproved parameter selects the outcome written to auditOutcomes
auditContract writes the audit outcome
auditContract reads the reward from rewards
calcCommission is invoked with the reward amount
calcCommission multiplies amount by commission using SafeMath.mul
calcCommission reads the commission state variable
computed commission is added to availableCommission
auditContract increases availableCommission
auditContract decreases totalRequestsAmount
auditContract uses SafeMath.sub for reward and commission math
auditContract performs an external Ether transfer to the auditor
reward minus commission, derived from user funded rewards, is transferred out
changeCommission is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
commission state variable is set from the _newCommission parameter
MAX_COMMISION constant bounds the new commission value
changeCommission writes the commission state variable
_amount parameter feeds the calcCommission computation
withdrawCommission is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
availableCommission is reduced by the owner supplied _amount
withdrawCommission writes availableCommission
withdrawCommission uses SafeMath.sub for the balance reduction
withdrawCommission performs an external Ether transfer to the owner
owner supplied _amount is sent out via the external transfer
SolidStamp.unpause override is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
override calls super.unpause after the upgrade check
require(newContractAddress == address(0)) blocks unpausing an upgraded contract
whenPaused modifier reads paused in the override
override ultimately flips paused back to false
fallback function unconditionally reverts direct payments from callers

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only consumed by transferOwnership when writing owner
_v2Address is only consumed by setNewAddress when writing newContractAddress
_auditor only feeds the keccak256 reward/request keys inside requestAudit
_codeHash only feeds the request keys inside requestAudit
_auditTime is only bounded and added to now inside requestAudit
_auditor only builds the hash keys used by withdrawRequest
_codeHash only builds the hash keys used by withdrawRequest
_codeHash only builds the auditor/code hash used by auditContract
_isApproved only selects the auditOutcomes value written by auditContract
_newCommission only bounds and stores the commission state variable
_amount only bounds the payout and the external transfer in withdrawCommission
_amount is the sole input of the calcCommission view computation
temporary key local used only to index rewards and auditOutcomes inside requestAudit
temporary read of auditOutcomes used only for the NOT_AUDITED require in requestAudit
temporary read of rewards used only to accumulate the new reward in requestAudit
temporary timestamp-derived value stored into the audit request inside requestAudit
temporary request key built from msg.sender used only inside requestAudit
storage pointer aliasing the auditRequests entry written inside requestAudit
storage pointer aliasing the auditRequests entry read and cleared in withdrawRequest
amount local is the value that is sent out by the external transfer in withdrawRequest
reward local determines the value leaving the contract through the external transfer in auditContract
commission local is the accrual value added to availableCommission in auditContract
